description: This PHP source file defines the Facebook class, which extends the BaseFacebook class to add functionality for managing Facebook sessions via PHP sessions and shared cookies. It includes methods for constructing, initializing shared sessions, persisting data, and managing cookies, with specific focus on session handling for Facebook authentication.

classes.name: Facebook
classes.description: A class extending BaseFacebook, adding session management features such as shared session initialization, persistent data handling using PHP sessions, and cookie management for Facebook authentication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Facebook object, optionally starting a PHP session and initializing shared session management based on configuration.

methods.name: initSharedSession
methods.description: Sets up a shared session using a signed request cookie, or creates a new shared session ID and sets a cookie if none exists.

methods.name: setPersistentData
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the PHP session, supporting specific keys.

methods.name: getPersistentData
methods.description: Retrieves stored data by key from the PHP session, with a default fallback.

methods.name: clearPersistentData
methods.description: Removes stored data by key from the session.

methods.name: clearAllPersistentData
methods.description: Clears all stored persistent data and deletes shared session cookie if present.

methods.name: getSharedSessionCookieName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shared session cookie based on app ID.

methods.name: constructSessionVariableName
methods.description: Constructs session variable name based on app ID and shared session ID.
